Companion Animal Travel Desk Incident Report

At the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways, routine processing ran in a calm, humane flow. Marcus Osei and Amara Muller arrived with Mabel and requested standard assistance. We confirmed the desk had current paperwork, ensured the waiting area stayed quiet, and double-checked seating and carrier placement so the animal could remain comfortable. During setup, a staff member adjusted the work surface for better visibility and briefly displaced a binder, which could have created a minor trip risk near the intake aisle.

We paused service, cleared the area immediately, and rerouted the binder to its storage spot. The safety coordinator reviewed the work zone for hazards and reinforced prevention steps for keeping common items secured while animals are handled. Staff updated the desk ledger to record the service change and the correction made to restore safe access routes.

Follow-up included a short refresher on hazard scanning before each intake and on maintaining gentle handling practices throughout desk workflow.
